intro:
Just 59 Honda Accords were sold in Australia in the first nine months of 2026 – while Toyota sold 9,471 Camrys. In a record-breaking new-car market, these are the 10 new cars Australians are refusing to buy, ranked by year-to-date sales, with the prices, the price cuts and the reasons behind them. Plus October's shockers – cars that sold just one or two units.

All sales figures are official VFACTS data (as compiled by GoAuto and CarExpert). Only cars still on sale are ranked; low sales don't necessarily mean a car is bad.
chapters: What it means for buyers and owners
